desc:
Moons of preparation have finally led us to the perfect destination, Warrior Cats: Lake Territory!
Bring your very own Warrior Cat to life and immortalize your story in "The Lake Territory" for the first time. This private beta gives you an exclusive look at our newest features and content before the free, public release.

Please note the following before joining:
🚧 Under construction: most of what you'll see in game is not final and is subject to change. Please bear with us as we work on any issues or unfinished components of the game.
🐞 Cats like bugs, but we don't: if you encounter anything that doesn't seem to work properly, please report them in our Community Server.
⚠️ Temporary morphs: your player data and characters created during this play-test are not guaranteed to be saved in the future official launch. But if you lose your morph DURING the play-test please report it in our Community Server.


Thank you, warriors, and have fun!
